description: Source code implementing transformations of various tensor constraints for the PyTorch FX migration framework, specifically to facilitate the migration of gradual tensor types and constraints related to tensor operations like transpose, index select, reshape, broadcasting, convolution, max pooling, and others.

classes.name: Constraint
classes.description: Base class for all constraints used in tensor type refinement.

classes.name: Conj
classes.description: Represents a conjunction (logical AND) of multiple constraints.

classes.name: Disj
classes.description: Represents a disjunction (logical OR) of multiple constraints.

classes.name: BinConstraintT
classes.description: Binary constraint involving tensor types, such as size or shape constraints.

classes.name: GetItemTensor
classes.description: Constraint representing tensor getitem operation with tensor index.

classes.name: CalcConv
classes.description: Constraint related to convolution operation parameters.

classes.name: CalcMaxPool
classes.description: Constraint related to max pooling operation parameters.

classes.name: TGreatestUpperBound
classes.description: Constraint representing the greatest upper bound of tensor shapes.

classes.name: DGreatestUpperBound
classes.description: Constraint representing the greatest upper bound of dimensions.

methods.name: register_transformation_rule(call_target)
methods.description: Decorator to register transformation functions for specific constraint types.

methods.name: transform_constraint(constraint: Constraint, counter: int)
methods.description: Dispatches and applies the appropriate transformation rule to a constraint.

methods.name: valid_index(index, dims)
methods.description: Checks if a given index is valid for tensor dimensions.

methods.name: valid_index_tensor(index, dims)
methods.description: Checks if a tuple of indices is valid for tensor dimensions, considering slices.

methods.name: transform_get_item(constraint, counter)
methods.description: Transforms GetItem constraints into shape and index validity constraints.

methods.name: transform_get_item_tensor(constraint, counter)
methods.description: Transforms GetItemTensor constraints with index tuples into shape constraints.

methods.name: transform_index_select(constraint, counter)
methods.description: Transforms IndexSelect constraints into validation and shape constraints.

methods.name: generate_binconstraint_t(constraint, counter)
methods.description: Transforms binary tensor constraints into constraints involving dimensions.

methods.name: generate_binconstraint_d(constraint, counter)
methods.description: Transforms binary dimension constraints into shape constraints.

methods.name: generate_conj(constraint, counter)
methods.description: Transforms conjunction constraints by recursively transforming each sub-constraint.

methods.name: generate_disj(constraint, counter)
methods.description: Transforms disjunction constraints by recursively transforming each sub-constraint.

methods.name: generate_gub(constraint, counter)
methods.description: Transforms greatest upper bound constraints for tensors into shape and dimension constraints.

methods.name: generate_d_gub(constraint, counter)
methods.description: Transforms greatest upper bound constraints for dimensions into equality constraints.

methods.name: generate_calc_conv(constraint, counter)
methods.description: Transforms convolution parameters into tensor shape constraints.

methods.name: generate_calc_maxpool(constraint, counter)
methods.description: Transforms max pooling parameters into tensor shape constraints.

methods.name: generate_calc_product(constraint, counter)
methods.description: Transforms flattening constraints into shape constraints with product calculations.

methods.name: generate_reshape(constraint, counter)
methods.description: Transforms reshape constraints into shape and size constraints.

methods.name: generate_all_reshape_possibilities
methods.description: Generates all possible constraints for different reshape configurations considering dynamic dimensions.

methods.name: broadcast_dim(tensor_input1, tensor_input2, res1, res2, index, padding=False)
methods.description: Creates constraints for broadcasting a specific dimension, considering padding.

methods.name: generate_broadcasting(constraint, counter)
methods.description: Generates constraints related to broadcasting two tensor shapes with and without padding.

methods.name: gen_consistency_constraints(constraint: Constraint, counter: int)
methods.description: Generates constraints ensuring shape consistency between two tensors.

methods.name: gen_greatest_upper_bound(constraint: TGreatestUpperBound, counter: int)
methods.description: Generates shape constraints for the least upper bound of two tensor shapes.

methods.name: generate_all_broadcasting_possibilities_no_padding( d1: list[DVar], d2: list[DVar], d11: list[DVar], d12: list[DVar] )
methods.description: Generates all possible broadcasting constraints assuming no padding, across all dimensions.

methods.name: gen_broadcasting_constraints( e1: TVar, e2: TVar, e11: TVar, e12: TVar, i: int, counter: int )
methods.description: Simulates broadcasting and returns constraints for the resulting shapes.

methods.name: apply_padding( e1_var: TVar, e11: BinConstraintT, e2: BinConstraintT, e12: BinConstraintT, d2: list[DVar], d11: list[DVar], d12: list[DVar], counter: int, )
methods.description: Generates constraints to model tensor padding for broadcasting.

methods.name: no_broadcast_dim_with_index( d1: list[DVar], d2: list[DVar], d3: list[DVar], d4: list[DVar], i: int )
methods.description: Constraints for dimensions when no broadcasting occurs at a particular index.

methods.name: gen_lists_of_dims(num_tensors: int, dim_size: int, counter: int)
methods.description: Generates lists of dimension variables for multiple tensors.

methods.name: create_equality_constraints_for_broadcasting( e1: TVar, e2: TVar, e11: TVar, e12: TVar, d1: list[DVar], d2: list[DVar], d11: list[DVar], d12: list[DVar], )
methods.description: Creates constraints ensuring shapes are equal when broadcasting occurs without padding.
